editorial:
Imagine the tension of a ticking clock combined with a scary game of cat and mouse. You follow Lyric, a woman who is completely heartbroken after her sister was murdered a year ago. She is not just sitting around waiting for answers; she is actively hunting the killer who targeted the local dancers. The vibe is dark and gritty, making you feel the danger every time a new character enters a room. It feels like a race against time because the killer is back on the anniversary of the first crime, and he is looking for his next favorite victim.

What really works here is how the suspense builds up without feeling too slow. The acting is solid, and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some of the kills are a bit over the top, it adds to the horror fun. If you love slashers, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture quality, or just rent it on Apple TV for a movie night. If you are a big movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move.
endingExplained: In the final act, you find out the killer is actually the club owner who wanted to keep his secrets hidden. Lyric manages to trap him in the dressing room using the same tools he used on others. After a brutal fight, she kills him to get justice for her sister. The movie ends with her finally finding peace, though she is scarred by the night's events.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves mystery slashers and strong female leads.
